turns.user: Can I place a direct order for ₹80,000 of cartons without raising a purchase request first?
turns.agent:
No. A direct purchase order without a request is allowed only when its gross value, including GST, is ₹50,000 or less. Every purchase outside of that rule must start with a purchase request.

Source: Purchase Policy §3.3; Purchase Policy §3.1

turns.user: Can I still charge new orders to cost centre PRD-05?
turns.agent:
Yes, but only if PRD-05 is open, because every order must be charged to an open cost centre. A closed cost centre cannot carry new spend, so you must check its status on screen FIN-CC-01 or ask Finance before raising an order.

Source: Purchase Policy §4.2; Purchase Policy §4.1
